integrity: The weighted incidence, norm convention and all ranges are explicit. Infinite-family assertions have a direct mathematical proof; finite symbolic checks are supplemental, not exhaustive; prior Green-inverse methodology is credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern only the canonical conductance-normalized orthogonal pair on real coordinate ell_1/ell_infinity, not minimum norms over arbitrary projections or intermediate ell_p. An equivalent treatment in incompletely indexed electrical-current literature cannot be excluded.
title: A moving conductance threshold for sharp cut–cycle projection norms on weighted wheels
